phase: Telnyx Webhook Acknowledgement And Retry Policy
objective: Map landed correlated Telnyx event application outcomes into a pure provider-webhook acknowledgement policy without constructing an HTTP response or duplicating persistence behavior.
rationale: Applied events are durably handled or deduplicated by the landed application stack and must be acknowledged.
correlation-not-found can represent webhook delivery racing local call-leg correlation persistence and therefore preserves provider redelivery.
stale-bridge, deferred, and stale-attempt explicitly carry retryable=true in the landed application contract.

orphaned-correlation, bridge-not-found, and attempt-not-found are structural internal inconsistencies not declared retryable by D3; provider redelivery is not used as an unbounded internal repair loop.
Durable provider-event receipt ownership remains exclusively in the landed D2 reconciliation executor.

output.acknowledge: Whether the later transport layer should return a provider-success acknowledgement.
output.retry: Whether the later transport layer should intentionally permit provider redelivery.

invariants: acknowledge and retry are logical opposites.
Every ApplyTelnyxCorrelatedEventResult variant is mapped exhaustively.
No HTTP status code is selected in this slice.
No Response object is created in this slice.
No D1 access or provider-event receipt write occurs in this slice.
No signature verification or JSON parsing occurs in this slice.
next: INS-002F4 composes verified normalized webhook events with the landed D1 correlated application and this acknowledgement policy.
